items.html: However, all the other couplings of ZON, of the aspect of face to face, are below, in the house of the Nukva, which is in the palace of the Nukva; and there ZA descends to couple with her. And behold, at that time the Mayin Nukvin of the Nukva were not yet clarified and corrected, as above; and it follows that the Mayin Nukvin that Malchut raised to ZA are the Mayin Nukvin of Bina, which served the Nukva; and by means of these Mayin Nukvin, Adam and Eve emerged so elevated, clinging up to the very top, as will be stated, with God's help.
